summary.text: Wallace Aristide, a Democrat, represents District 107 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2024, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Aristide as an educator from Miami who worked in the public school system for 35 years, and who was born in Nassau, Bahamas, and moved to Florida in 1969.
Aristide has a B.S. in criminal justice from Bethune-Cookman University and a master's in exceptional student education from Nova Southeastern University.
